newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - West Genesse CSD, N.Y.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF BOND SALE
West Genesee Central School District,
(Onondaga County),
New York
School District (Serial) Bonds, Series 1997A
(Bank Qualified) (Book-Entry-Only)

SEALED PROPOSALS will be received and considered by th undersigned President of the Board of Education of the West Genesee Central School District, Onondaga County, New York (the Issuer''), at the office of Fleet Securities, Inc., 14 Wall Street, 23rd Floor, New York, New York 10005 at 12:00 Noon Prevailing Time, on the
5th day of June, 1997,

at which time and place the bids will be opened, for the purchase IN FEDERAL FUNDS at not less than par and accrued interest of $5,970,000 School District (Serial) Bonds, Series 1997A (the Bonds'' suer, dated June 15, 1997, and maturing on June 15 in each of the years as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount
2001 550,000 The Bonds are not subject to redemption prior to maturity.
Interest on the Bonds is payable on June 15 and December 15 of each year, commencing December 15, 1997.

The Bonds will be awarded to the Bidder offering to purchase the Bonds at such rate or rates of interest as will produce the lowest net interest cost in accordance with the terms set forth in the Notice of Sale.

The right is reserved to reject any or all bids, and any bid not complying with this Notice of Sale will be rejected. Each bid must be enclosed in a sealed envelope addressed to the undersigned President of the Board of Education of the Issuer, and should be marked on the outside Proposal for Bonds'' and should be accompanied with a certified or cashier's check drawn upon an incorporated bank or trust company to the order of the West Genesee Central School District for $119,400 as a good faith deposit to secure the Issuer against any loss resulting from the failure of the bidder to comply with the terms of his bids. No interest will be allowed on the amount of the good faith deposit.

THE ISSUER RESERVES THE RIGHT TO CHANGE THE TIME AND/OR DATE FOR THE OPENING OF BIDS. NOTICE OF ANY SUCH CHANGE WILL BE PROVIDED NOT LESS THAN 24 HOURS PRIOR TO THE TIME SET FORTH ABOVE FOR THE OPENING OF BIDS BY MEANS OF A
SUPPLEMENTAL NOTICE OF SALE TO BE TRANSMITTED OVER THE MUNIFACTS WIRE.
As a condition to the purchaser's obligation to accept delivery of and pay for the Bonds, the purchaser will be furnished, without cost, the unqualified legal opinion as to
the validity of the Bonds of Bond, Schoeneck & King, Syracuse, New York, Bond Counsel.
The Bonds will be designated qualified tax-exempt
obligations'' pursuant to Section 265(b)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code, as amended.

Copies of the Notice of Sale herein summarized and the Official Statement relating to the Bonds may be obtained from Fiscal Advisors & Marketing, Inc., P.O. Box 1429, 6221 Route 31, Cicero, New York 13039; Phone (315) 699-7912; Fax (315) 699-8833. Additional Official Statements may be
downloaded from Fiscal Advisors & Marketing, Inc.'s Internet address: http://www.fiscaladvisors.com.
Dated: May 27, 1997
STEPHEN P. MISKELL
PRESIDENT OF THE BOARD OF EDUCATION
(From The Bond Buyer)
